LBR.note: CBL is called the regulator of mobile money operations, but no licensing, switch or PAPSS role is stated.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Liberia fined Lonestar Cell MTN Mobile Money for breaches of mobile money regulations and corporate governance standards, rejected its appeal, and the fine was paid; the amount is not given.

systems.owner: Lonestar Cell MTN Mobile Money Inc.

LBR.note: The breaches are of mobile money and governance rules, not stated to be user-protection rules.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The Central Bank of Liberia fined a mobile money provider for persistent breaches of its mobile money regulations, which it enforces as the regulator overseeing mobile money operations.
Lonestar Cell MTN Mobile Money Inc. is described as a prominent mobile money provider in Liberia operating under Central Bank of Liberia regulation.

LBR.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
